items.Sentence: Section VI.C. 6.a requires the wastewater is oxidized, filtered, and adequately disinfected pursuant to Title 22, or equivalent, seasonally from 1 May through 31 October.
The conditionally accepted Title 22 Engineering Report allows use of free chlorine disinfection and high filter loading rates that are not consistent with Title 22.
Effective 9 May 2023, ... when discharging to surface water, wastewater shall be oxidized, filtered, and adequately disinfected pursuant to Title 22, or equivalent, requirements...

Facility description in section II.A.2 of the Fact Sheet where some BNR effluent does not receive filtration, a study of November – April performance of the filtration and disinfection system will be required of the Discharger.
The Discharger currently accepts hauled-in ADM for direct injection into its anaerobic digester for co-digestion.

The operation and maintenance specifications for the ESB’s are necessary to protect the beneficial uses of the groundwater. The specifications included in this Order are retained from Order R5-2016-0020-01.
